name: GO-UNITTEST-BENCH
description: GO-UNITTEST-BENCH evaluates a model's ability to generate correct Go (Golang) unit tests or implementations that satisfy provided unit-test specifications. The benchmark measures functional correctness by running generated code against test suites and checking whether tests pass. It is intended to assess code-generation models' reliability for Go software engineering tasks.
reputation: A niche benchmark used by researchers working on code generation for Go; limited but growing adoption within the code-model evaluation community.
